study_design: Prospective nested case-control study within the Multiethnic Cohort
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The study included 329 incidents of prostate cancer of African American, Native Hawaiian, Japanese, Latino and White ancestry, and 656 controls matched on age, race/ethnicity, date/time of blood collection and fasting status.
reason: The prospective nested case-control analysis evaluates incident prostate cancer overall. The abstract does not define or analyze high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or another aggressive incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The study included 329 incidents of prostate cancer of African American, Native Hawaiian, Japanese, Latino and White ancestry, and 656 controls matched on age, race/ethnicity, date/time of blood collection and fasting status.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns incident prostate cancer overall; no aggressive subtype is specified. The supplied value is the inverse of the abstract's reported OR, but inversion does not alter endpoint classification.

validation_findings: Nested case-control/case-cohort analytic denominator must not be forced to full-cohort N
